status: Implemented; recorded focused/client evidence retained and final full/native regressions passed. See the stated verification scope.
electrical: 800 V original high-voltage cable load, private subsystem, root horizontal floor contacts plus two ghost power nodes at (-1,0,+1) and (-1,0,-1). Each ghost accepts all four horizontal floor directions. Working resistor 800 squared divided by configured charging watts. Default 2000 W, original GUI range 2000–20000 W; idle high impedance. Original voltage watchdog and strength-three machine failure.
names: Default source and destination names are both Unnamed. Destination matching is exact and dimension-local across loaded devices. Same name, missing destination, ambiguous name and unavailable/busy destination are distinct errors. Name, destination and power settings may change only while idle.
chamber: Original chamber is (-1,0,0), one block square and two blocks high. Its base reservation uses GhostBlock.tFloor, whose actual collision height is 1/16 block. Arrival preserves each entity's offset, rotation and motion by applying the difference between chamber origins.
reservation: A destination reserves only from idle with at least 640 V. The master refreshes its paired door state and progress on every 20 Hz step. Missing master refresh releases the reservation/open door. Target matching and ownership must survive circuit rebuilding without stale callbacks binding a replaced machine.
states: 0 Idle: a one-shot Start request validates exact target count, different name and both supplies, reserves the target and enters Start.
1 Start: require at least one entity continuously in the source chamber for more than two seconds; empty chamber resets that timer.
2 Close: close/reserve door immediately, wait more than three seconds, then enter Charge or return to the slave Reserved state.
3 Charge: play original transporter sound every 18 source steps, reject missing/ambiguous/same-name target and unstable power; add actual resistor work until the current required energy is paid.
4 Teleport: apply the saved destination displacement to all current chamber entities on the next positive-time step, then open.
5 Open: wait more than three seconds, then idle or slave reserved.
6 Reserved: mirror master doors/progress while refreshed; otherwise reopen or idle.
7 Reset: original reload resets an interrupted transport; no unfinished reservation should survive without its actual partner.
required_joules: (10000 + 40000*players + 5000*otherLivingEntities + 5000*itemEntities) * (1 + sqrt(chamberDistance/250)). Recomputed from actual current source occupants. The master's finite paid charge is consumed/discarded when it leaves Charge; slave display does not create electrical energy.
source_hazard: During Charge, voltage below 640 V randomly relocates chamber occupants by up to 1000 blocks and opens. The legacy path queries arbitrary chunks and uses an unbounded vertical loop; a native adaptation must bound lookup and stay within loaded valid columns rather than hang or load an arbitrary background region.
reservations_geometry: Base side walls: x -2..0, y 0..1, z +/-1; rear side walls x -3, y 0..1,z +/-1; roof x -4..-1,y2,z0; root upper cell; chamber floor x-1,y0,z0. Open door roof cells x-4..-3,y2,z0 overlap base roof, and closed door is x-2,y0..1,z0. Original transitions briefly reserve both while doors move.
visuals: Transporter OBJ, original translation (-1,0,0), main/control/power housings, -90-degree opening doors around their Z pivots, gyro spinning on original (-.11746,.04275,0) axis with both pivots from the model metadata, orange charge glow, ten status LEDs, six screen glyph groups, white/blue charging blur. Held model is 3D, inventory is the original flat sprite. Original door PhysicalInterpolator(.2,8,5,0), maximum speed .3; charge-ratio RC1, blue-opacity RC.5.
crafting: Original pattern RMR/RMR/ R , Advanced Machine Block M and Advanced Chip R. Original includes an unused High Voltage Cable C mapping; native recipe restoration must omit that unused key to satisfy the modern serializer.

verification.live_review: Actual name/destination/power/Start packets, physical paired doors, 20 kW paid charging, actual player plus unpickable item arrival, reservation release and original open-door/gyro/status/held routes passed; screenshots reviewed.

It now waits a bounded interval for actual participating chunks and a beam scan, with explicit clear weather and detailed state diagnostics. Full 230-case regression is next.
